name: hris
description: - FRONT-END: open each page's index.html with Live Server. Fill in FRONT-END/shared/firebase-config.js. - BACK-END: fill in .env, then `npm install` and `npm run dev`. - Firebase console: enable Authentication (Email/Password) and create a Firestore database.

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c red,blue "npm --prefix BACK-END start" "http-server FRONT-END -p 5501 -c-1"
